# Contributing / 参与贡献

欢迎使用中文或英文反馈和贡献。使用与网络问题请到 [Discussions](https://github.com/EnchantGapple233/Minedock/discussions)；可复现错误和具体功能建议请用 [Issue 模板](https://github.com/EnchantGapple233/Minedock/issues/new/choose)。提交前先搜索已有记录。

Chinese and English contributions are welcome. Use Discussions for usage and connectivity questions, and issue forms for reproducible bugs or concrete proposals. Search existing reports first.

## 修改前 / Before Editing

阅读 [维护规则](../AGENTS.md)、[更新日志](../CHANGELOG.md)、[验证记录](../VALIDATION.md)和[发布回归清单](../docs/RELEASE-CHECKLIST.md)。构建、测试与发布命令见[开发指南](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) / [English](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.en.md)。

Read the maintenance rules, changelog, validation record, and release checklist. The development guide contains build, check, and publishing commands.

- 保持修改范围集中，说明实际问题及修改后的行为。Keep changes focused and describe the problem and resulting behavior.
- 保留原始启动器、许可、对应源码、校验与事务保护。Preserve original launchers, licenses, corresponding source, verification, and transactional protection.
- 默认运行核心和完整界面检查，并按影响补做联网、安装或单 EXE 验证。Run core and full UI checks, then applicable live, installation, or single-EXE checks.
- 使用独立测试目录，禁止对日常游戏目录做恢复或破坏性测试。Use isolated fixtures rather than personal game directories.
- 文档与界面变化附截图；记录本次执行命令、结果及未测试范围。Attach screenshots for visible changes and state commands, results, and untested areas.
- 不重写历史更新条目，不把既有功能重复记为新增。Preserve historical release entries and avoid presenting existing behavior as new.

提交 Pull Request 即表示你有权按本项目 GPL-3.0-or-later 许可提供相应贡献。发布、标签及关联 Issue 的关闭由维护者确认后执行。

By submitting a pull request, you confirm you can contribute under this project's GPL-3.0-or-later license. Releases, tags, and closing associated issues require maintainer confirmation.

安全漏洞请遵循[安全政策](SECURITY.md)，不要放进公开 Issue。

Follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md) for vulnerabilities rather than public issues.
